topic.title: DiffMS Pretrained Checkpoints — Reproducibility and Competition Eligibility
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
I'm looking into pretrained molecular structure generators, particularly DiffMS, and had a few questions.

The DiffMS maintainers acknowledged a reproducibility issue with the MIST encoder in GitHub issue #27.

Has anyone seen a corrected DiffMS checkpoint release?

Is there a verified training-data provenance record confirming that the released weights do not rely on restricted NIST data?

Has anyone confirmed whether these pretrained weights are eligible under the competition's external-data rules?

Are there other publicly available spectrum-to-structure generators with clearly documented training sources and pretrained checkpoints?

Any official references or clarifications would be appreciated.
